positive_candidates.scope: Supplied untilted massless noncompact Hall-free quartet, unbroken time reversal and gauge-preserving weak-coupling action; not native phase construction.
positive_candidates.assessment: Linear weighted star flow has conserved weighted common metric, detailed balance weights n_i and 2, dissipation -4 sum n_i q_i^2 ||C_i-C_g||^2. N=2 mean mismatch z^-2 and contrasts z^-1. Quadratic constitutive variance W=2(<C^2>-<C>^2)_tf and history integrals yield stated z^-1-z^-4 and z^-1-z^-2 coefficients; N=4 resonance and isotropic variance exception retained. Closed Weyl bubbles half Dirac; external self energy has no cone multiplicity.

positive_candidates.scope: Separate fixed a,g>0 homogeneous bounded-shift rotor/CAR Hamiltonian; supplied local dynamics theorem; joint volume/cutoff limit with arbitrary relative rates.
positive_candidates.assessment: Onsite physical product trial state gives cutoff/volume-uniform electric second moments, local tail control and trace compactness. Gauss law passes through bounded exponentials. Compressed physical core ground inequality and local dynamics convergence yield nonnegative GNS generator. Translation/time-reversal averaging can give mixed states. This proves neither phase, purity, uniqueness, gap nor g-uniform continuum compactness. Eight of nine displayed numerical dynamics bounds are trivial and disclosed.

positive_candidates.scope: Quadratic coframe expansion in same supplied continuum action; finite perturbative order, no uniform all-scale remainder.
positive_candidates.assessment: Full Feynman-parameter expansion and essential temporal subtraction give -8C/3-2C^2+tr(C)C/3. Photon metric extraction gives mean C minus half mean contrast square. N=2 relative resonant source -V log(z)/(4z^2) and common drift -5V(1-z^-2)/16 are consistent; N=3 relative source cancels while common drift remains. Independent exact rational integral control confirms coefficients.

positive_candidates.scope: Specified zero-temperature filled-negative-state density, unit-normalized Weyl spinors and canonically normalized transverse photons; leading weak-coupling decay calculations.
positive_candidates.assessment: Strict fermion |Gp|/E>1 and photon |k|>|Vk| kinematic criteria, positive polarization tensors and isotropic formulas consistent. Generic interior margins cannot be extended uniformly to boundary. Shear boundary coefficient 7/(12pi) independently derived in written cap integral differs from naive generic substitution; actual quartet boundary needs quadratic photon metric and W. Generic quartet widths fall as z^-2 but do not prove a pole, residue, phase or absence of infraparticles.
